summary: Follow-up to #31074 that passes the operation tolerance and the SortingMode-derived keepOrder flag into combineHorizontalFaces for Pocket Shape and Profile, sets the SortingMode enumeration during document restore, tidies comments and a log message in Geom.py, and extends the unit test; no task-panel control, property, default, enumeration, menu entry, or documented output changes.

pages.reason: Path/Op/PocketShape.py: areaOpShapes now forwards tol and reads obj.SortingMode directly; internal bug fix completing #31074, property set and panel unchanged

Path/Op/Profile.py: _processBase now passes keepOrder from the existing SortingMode property and self.tol; makes the already-documented 'Manual: uses order of shapes selection' behaviour apply to combined horizontal faces, no new property or value
Path/Geom.py: comment edits and reworded Path.Log.info message in combineHorizontalFaces; helper is not the CAM Area command this page documents
Path/Op/PocketBase.py: opOnDocumentRestored migration only; Engrave does not use PocketBase SortingMode
Path/Op/PocketBase.py: opOnDocumentRestored sets SortingMode enumeration ('Automatic','Manual') on restored documents; migration fix, enumeration values already existed for new objects
Path/Op/PocketBase.py: opOnDocumentRestored migration only; no property, default, or enumeration added for new objects
